name: Wharton Global High School Investment Competition
org: Wharton Global Youth Program, University of Pennsylvania
what_you_do: Teams of four to six run a pretend portfolio on the Wharton Investment Simulator. They write a trading review, a plan for investing and a final report. The top 10 teams go to Wharton for the finale.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12 on a team of four to six with a teacher advisor.
duration: Trading starts Sept 28, 2026, then virtual semifinals (date not posted) and a finale Apr 29 to 30, 2027 (2026-27 cycle)
deadline_text: Registration for 2026-27 is closed (it ran Aug 10 to Sept 11, 2026). Trading began Sept 28, 2026. Finale Apr 29 to 30, 2027, at Wharton in Philadelphia, PA.
how_to_apply: A teacher advisor and the team register on the Wharton Global Youth site. The page does not give a date for the next cycle's registration; check the site.
notes: Sign-up steps are on the Rules and Roles and Register pages, which were not read. Travel costs to the finale were not stated.
